blocking: The English-only rule permits Persian accents, but weddings.html also renders Hindi, Punjabi and Urdu text.
The focused How we work tab explicitly bypasses destination hiding, so scrolling with keyboard focus on it can leave it covering the footer.

fixes.where: weddings.html — Haldi & Pheras, Anand Karaj, Reception & Walima
fixes.what: Remove the lang="hi", lang="pa" and lang="ur" accents; retain the English ceremony names and permitted Persian accents.
fixes.why: These visible strings violate the stated language rule, capping the score at 6.

fixes.what: Give inquiry/footer collision protection precedence over focused-tab visibility. When hiding a focused tab becomes necessary, move focus to a visible equivalent control before hiding it.
fixes.why: Both functions currently exempt the focused tab from hiding, defeating the owner's absolute clearance requirement.

fixes.what: Use el.validity.valid instead of el.checkValidity() during input; reserve checkValidity()/reportValidity() for submission.
fixes.why: checkValidity() dispatches invalid events while typing, immediately generating errors for unfinished email addresses before submission.

fixes.what: Run fitHero() and its resize/font listeners whenever main.canopy exists; gate only animation initialization on GSAP and ScrollTrigger availability.
fixes.why: The early dependency guard disables the supposedly motion-independent clearance measurement when a vendor fails, leaving short screens and enlarged text dependent on fixed estimates.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — form validation/status updates; assets/js/canopy.js — ground triggers
fixes.what: Refresh scroll measurements after validation messages, request status or textarea resizing changes form height; use a debounced ResizeObserver on the form.
fixes.why: These changes move the ground and footer after trigger measurement, leaving ground motion and maximum-scroll calculations stale.
